item_description:
Script: dpe tshugs.
Lines per folio: 5.
Double numbering of the folios, from 1 to 102 and from 323 to 425 (400 being represented by "xxxx"). The second set of numbers has both 397 and 398 written where the first set has 75.
Proofread (1 zhus dag).
The colophon seems to have been written in color in the original (vowels in black) and is not legible in the reproductions. So are the title of the base text in the incipit and lemmata from the base text.
